raw_text: Monitoring the Nagaland situation closely. OSINT signals on NSCN-IM ceasefire breakdown appeared on encrypted Telegram channels 6 hours before mainstream media. Tribal organizations used Facebook community groups and Telegram to coordinate shutdown logistics including specific road blockade positions. This early warning gap is significant for security planning.
clean_text: OSINT signals on NSCN-IM ceasefire breakdown detected 6 hours before mainstream media via encrypted Telegram. Facebook and Telegram used for shutdown logistics and road blockade coordination.
